cases.why: ملی sends from the four digits its cards start with, and writes بانك/ملي with Arabic letters. It states interest as «سود:…+» — a word no direction list has — so the + glued behind the figure is what makes it money arriving. The مانده is still the balance, stated rather than guessed, so it must not come back inferred. The trailing «0425-01:15» is a date with no slash in it and must be read as neither an account number nor a printed date.
